title: I actually can’t stop talking about @Benjamin Button The Musical plz ...
transcript: I was curious about Benjamin Button because I truly knew nothing about it I saw the movie many years ago but I didn't really remember the plot except like the basic concept of this is about a man aging backwards but everyone told me it was the show to see and so we went I was immediately charmed by the set and then as soon as it started I was all in the music is folksy and whimsical this is a weird comparison but it has like come from away vibes where it's like a community telling a story together side note the bar in the show is called The Pickled Crab and then you can actually go to the Pickled Crab outside the theater. it was very cute. but yes this is a story about a man who ages backwards but really it's about a man who is trying to find family and love and a place to belong and it is so beautifully told by these actors who also play all of the instruments the story has been moved from the states to a Cornish fishing village which is perfect cause it feels like this folktale that’s being passed along from Generation to Generation but I have to talk about score again because it is absolutely stunning they have not released a full cast recording yet but I cannot stop listening to three songs they have released if I have one regret from my London trip it's that I only saw this once uh we just got out of Benjamin button and that was the crazy thing I've seen in my entire life we look happy right now we're emotionally devastated it's so good. it’s so good. if you wanna see one new musical in London this is the one to see and please come to New York
